Message:
The sand, which withered
every form of life it touched,
began to consume the world.
“Liberia!”

Is that Ayse’s voice?
But...how...?

Breaking through
the storm of sand,
Ayse stretched her hand
towards me.

But, I did not take it.
Because, me and Ayse
cannot be together...!

The storm of sand
grew stronger.
But, Ayse did not give up.

“I’m sorry, Liberia.
But, the truth is...
I was happy to be your friend!

The two of us meeting
wasn’t a mistake!”

It was...!
Because, if we had not met,
Ayse would not have...!

“I don’t want to be
separated from you!
Because...I want to
stay as your friend.

That’s how I feel.
What about you?”
My feelings do not matter.

Because, if I follow
how I feel,
I will only make
another mistake.
So, I should just
follow our laws...

“What matters is
what you want!

Try and remember!
How you felt the first day
I taught you!”

...I remember.
That day, Ayse taught me.

She said following how I feel
is just as important as
following the laws of my tribe.

How I feel...?
There is only one thing
I want to do.
I...
“I want to be with you...!”

I reached out,
and Ayse squeezed
my hand tightly.

“Yeah... I want to be
with you, too, Liberia...!”
Ayse’s hands were so warm.

She broadened my horizons
and awakened these
feelings within me,
so meeting her
could never be a mistake.
Because...that is what I believe.
“I am happy I met you, Ayse.”

There are still lots of things
I do not know.
I am sure that is
the same for her...

So, from today,
we can keep teaching
each other new things.

That is something
only the two of us
together can do.

Something only
us friends can do—
